title: Winter storm and cold
summary: Stay warm and dry while watching for local weather warnings.
steps: Stay inside when travel is dangerous. If you must go out, dress in layers and keep exposed skin covered.
Use approved heating equipment safely and follow ventilation instructions. Never heat a home with a charcoal grill, camp stove, or oven.
Keep a flashlight, radio, blankets, and needed medicine available during power loss.
Seek medical help for suspected hypothermia, frostbite, or sudden worsening of health.
